summary.verdict: The implementation conforms to the documented motor_021 contract. It runs deterministic read-only integration checks over supplied contracts, version records, taxonomy snapshots, normalized records, identity records and quality records; emits TestResult, HarnessReport and IntegrationFailure structures; preserves versioning and lineage metadata on emitted objects; rejects invalid input with structured errors; and prevents aggregate pass when failed results or critical failures exist.

findings: The engine exposes DatasetObjectTestHarnessEngine.run with the documented key inputs: phase_contracts, version_records, canonical_taxonomy, normalized_records, identity_records and quality_records.
The implemented required cases match the test specification: contract_required_fields_present, version_ref_resolves, taxonomy_refs_allowed, identity_ref_resolves and quality_record_present.
The output payload uses the documented keys test_result, harness_report and integration_failure_log, backed by frozen dataclass models for TestResult, HarnessReport and IntegrationFailure.

Invalid structured inputs are rejected with HarnessInputError and documented error codes such as INVALID_HARNESS_INPUT, UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE, CONTRACT_MISMATCH, TAXONOMY_MISMATCH, LINEAGE_GAP and UNSAFE_HARNESS_REPORT.
HarnessReport.status is derived from result statuses and failure severity, so pass cannot be emitted while a required TestResult fails or a critical IntegrationFailure is linked.

Each emitted TestResult includes stable identifiers, case_version, harness_version, input_refs, expected_condition, observed_condition, failure_ids, severity, error_code, version_id, version_hash, source_ref, produced_by_motor, produced_at and parent_id.

Each emitted HarnessReport includes harness_run_id, test_result_ids, tested_contract_refs, tested_object_refs, result_counts, coverage_summary, failure_ids, failure_log_ref, status, decision_reason, version fields and lineage fields.

Each emitted IntegrationFailure includes failure_id, harness_run_id, test_id, failure_type, affected_object_ref, expected_ref, observed_value, source_input_refs, severity, owner_motor_ref, recommended_action, version fields and lineage fields.
Identifiers and semantic hashes are generated deterministically from canonicalized payloads, while non-semantic timestamp fields are excluded from version_hash material.
Report reconciliation checks validate result_counts, test_result_ids, failure_ids and linked failure references before returning a report.

test_results.coverage_assessment: Executable smoke verification covered the documented happy path and malformed input rejection path. Artifact review also checked coverage for sparse inputs, skipped coverage handling, taxonomy mismatches, lineage gaps, quality-record requirements and report reconciliation guards.
test_results.notes: The happy path emitted five passing TestResult records, a pass HarnessReport with result_counts {pass: 5, warning: 0, fail: 0, skipped: 0}, and an empty integration_failure_log. A malformed phase_contracts input was rejected with INVALID_HARNESS_INPUT. No source mutation path was found; run() deep-copies inputs at entry and rejects if the final input snapshot differs.
